name: apply_effect
description: Apply an active effect (spell, buff, or debuff) to one or more targets. Effects persist through combat rounds, auto-expire via advance_turn, and are automatically checked by roll_attack, roll_damage, and roll_saves. Built-in templates: bless (+1d4 to attacks/saves, concentration, 10r), bane (-1d4 to attacks/saves, concentration, 10r), hex (+1d6 necrotic damage, concentration, 60r), hunters_mark (+1d6 damage, concentration, 60r), faerie_fire (grants attackers advantage, concentration, 10r), guidance (+1d4 ability checks, concentration, 10r), haste (advantage on Dex saves, concentration, 10r), slow (-2 to attacks/saves, concentration, 10r), hold_person (grants attackers advantage, concentration, 10r). Pass modifiers to override any template. Use 'custom' for fully bespoke effects. For concentration spells, set source/source_type to the caster — clearing their concentration will remove the effect.

targets.description: One or more entities to apply the effect to.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a character or NPC.

entity.description: Slug or UUID of the target.

effect.description: Template name (bless, bane, hex, hunters_mark, faerie_fire, guidance, haste, slow, hold_person) or 'custom' for a fully specified effect.

source_type.description: Entity type of the caster or effect source.

source.description: Slug of the caster or source. For concentration spells this becomes the concentration owner — clearing their concentration removes this effect.

duration_rounds.description: Override the template duration in combat rounds. -1 for indefinite (must be removed manually). Auto-expires during advance_turn if combat is active.

modifiers.description: Override or specify the effect's modifiers. For Hex, include both the damage bonus and the ability-check disadvantage (specifying which ability). Each modifier must have type and roll_types.

type.description: bonus_dice/subtract_dice: add/subtract dice. flat_bonus/flat_penalty: static modifier. advantage/disadvantage: the holder rolls with adv/dis. grant_advantage: attackers/opponents have advantage vs the holder.

roll_types.description: Which roll types this modifier applies to.

dice.description: Dice expression for bonus_dice or subtract_dice, e.g. '1d4', '1d6'.

value.description: Numeric amount for flat_bonus or flat_penalty.

damage_type.description: Label for the type of bonus damage dealt (e.g. 'necrotic'). Informational only — appears in roll breakdowns.

ability.description: Restrict this modifier to one ability for saves or ability checks.

notes.description: Optional description. Used as the effect name for 'custom' effects.
